metric definition / evidence: mean over the 4 WOA quarters of the % of 60-90N ocean area with >=10 T profiles at 500 m; by quarter: JFM 25%, AMJ 26%, JAS 36%, OND 33%
comment: A 500 m quarterly proxy does not establish monthly support through 1500 m; interpolation choices require separate assessment.

purpose: Regional climatology of the Atlantic layer (north of 70N)
metric definition / evidence: % of mask ocean area in boxes with centres >=70N and >=10 T profiles at 300 m (all years); 35,610 central-Arctic profiles reach >=200 m
comment: Counts at 300 m are a coverage proxy, not property-based identification of Atlantic-layer water or regional representativeness.

metric definition / evidence: % of 60-90N mask ocean area with >=10 T profiles at 2000 m (shelves are included; not a bathymetry-limited deep-water fraction); 38,865 profiles (9.4%) have data below 1500 m
comment: Few values reach these depths; the metric does not identify their source platforms or their seasonal representativeness.

metric definition / evidence: mean over quarters of % ocean area with >=10 profiles at 10 m (0 m is empty, 5 m partly filled); by quarter: JFM 36%, AMJ 36%, JAS 58%, OND 47%
comment: No 0 m values; 5 m fill is 67.0%. Values at 10 m do not resolve mixed-layer structure or surface conditions.

metric definition / evidence: % ocean area with >=10 S profiles at 100 m (all years)
comment: A 100 m salinity count does not establish resolved halocline gradients, measurement quality or independent sampling.

metric definition / evidence: % ocean area sampled in >=10 distinct years (not accounting for profiles per year or season)
comment: Distinct-year counts do not ensure contiguous records, consistent locations/seasons or a valid trend uncertainty model.

purpose: Seasonal cycle in the central Arctic
metric definition / evidence: % of calendar months with >=100 central-Arctic profiles reaching >=200 m from >=10 distinct years; 12 of 12 months pass
comment: Only 2.2% of central-Arctic profiles predate 2003; Dec-Mar depth-reaching profiles cover 14-16 distinct years per month. Unequal year/location support can confound a seasonal comparison.

purpose: Eulerian time series at a point
metric definition / evidence: % mask ocean area in 100 km boxes with >=100 profiles, >=10 years, >=6 calendar months; candidate low-extent series: 32
comment: A sampled 100 km box is not a fixed-point time series; candidate low-extent chains also require original-record verification.

metric definition / evidence: % of WOA-mask 1 deg ocean cells north of 60N with >=10 profiles (all years, any depth; cell-count rather than area fraction)
comment: Evaluate at observed locations, times and depths; account for representativeness and possible overlap with model assimilation data.

metric definition / evidence: % ocean area with >=10 profiles reaching >=700 m (all years); by decade: 1983-1992 7%, 1993-2002 13%, 2003-2012 32%, 2013-2023 32%
comment: Depth reach alone does not ensure complete 0-700 m profiles, valid heat integration or representative basin/time coverage.
